notes: Strength: IMPs a board against BEN (64), the anchor (fixed at 0). BEN (64): an outside bot that does not change between generations, with boards against every generation from Gen 6 on.
Introduced: a bot's first board on a registered feed, unless it is known to have played earlier (introduced_source gives the evidence; Gen 1 predates the arena).
Each side bids with its own bidder (the native condition): the whole bot. Common-auction boards are not used.

Counting is the page's: records after a feed's snapshot, the hidden BEN (32) and the accidental cohorts are out; a feed's allowed pairs are respected; a deal family counts once per pair, earliest first; self-play carries no strength.

Priors come only from estimates outside the registered feeds (box matches), so no board counts twice; every other bot has a weak prior (SD 2.0 IMPs a board) at the field mean, a free parameter. A hollow point takes more than half its information from its own prior: prior share = 1 - (variance with its prior) / (variance without it).

Time per decision: wall-clock seconds per card decision with a choice, from the records' decision timing; card play only, host-dependent (Azure boxes, Codex and ChatGPT sandboxes differ), not CPU time.

Variants: a bot whose published settings differ between feeds (file paths and names ignored) is fitted per variant; a variant is merged into the bot's point when it differs by under 0.1 IMPs a board and by under two standard errors; a variant whose feed publishes no settings is merged unless its boards differ by two standard errors. Not merged: 1#330e78, ben64#41c8c9.
Candidates are not in the arena: placed at a registered bot's strength plus an outside match estimate, and marked.
